title: Validated planning artifact paths
responsibility: Recognizes exact planning files and their ancestor directories only when the containing plan and contract hash are valid.

inputs.name: planningArtifactPaths.root
inputs.description: Repository root used to read plan and optional unit manifests; undefined returns an empty set.

inputs.name: planningArtifactPaths.files
inputs.description: Repository-relative paths to examine for supported plan, design, approval and thread artifacts.

outputs.name: planningArtifactPaths
outputs.description: Set of accepted artifact paths and ancestor directory paths ending in slash. Invalid plans, mismatched locations/hashes and unrelated files contribute nothing; no files are changed.
